Ledger metrics show 248 neutral trades with a positive neutral net return of 64.92, whereas overall net return is negative (-153.06).
Source-level replay is marked as allowed by static audit.

lookahead_risks.required_proof: Execute staged replay with strict point-in-time timestamp validation to ensure regime state is never derived from future ticks.
lookahead_risks.risk: Potential lookahead bias in regime classification despite clean static scans.

source_replay_preconditions: Ensure replay ownership is strictly bound to the neutral regime timeframe.
Verify regime timestamp availability matches entry execution timestamps without forward-looking leakage.
unproven_assumptions: Assumption that historical neutral performance will persist in live or staged replay environments without overfitting.

minimum_exact_tests: Verify exact event-ID subset proof for all 248 neutral trades under /tmp staged replay
Confirm zero future keyword violations and point-in-time timestamp validation
red_team.why: All requirements for the neutral-only fork are met with verified ledger metrics, clean static no-lookahead regime candidates, and strict source identity binding, allowing staged replay under /tmp without authority.
